title: October 19, 2026
body:
This serverless compute release includes updates from [Databricks Runtime 19](/aws/en/release-notes/runtime/19).

#### Behavior changes

* **Spark Connect execution metrics hide row filter and column mask details**: DataFrame execution metrics now hide internal operators and metrics associated with row filters and column masks. This protects information about policy execution when you inspect `df.executionInfo.metrics`, including its text representation. The boundary of the protected portion of the plan and its own metrics remain visible. Query results are unchanged. Notebooks or tools that depend on detailed metrics inside protected subplans might need to be updated.
